summary.tldr: Requires the CRTC to consult Quebec or provincial governments before regulating broadcasting matters tied to Quebec’s cultural distinctiveness or French-speaking markets.
what_it_does: Requires the CRTC to consult the Government of Quebec about Quebec’s cultural distinctiveness, and other provincial governments about French-speaking markets, before exercising its powers on those broadcasting matters.
summary.background: It amends section 12 of the Canadian Radio-television and Telecommunications Commission Act.
